release.title: Profile 2.8.0 — Live Visual Evidence Edition
release.summary: A visual release. The profile described Ivrit Sheli 2.12.3 in words but illustrated it with 2.2.0 captures from an interface that no longer exists, and said so in small print. It now shows the reviewed 2.12.3 frames the project itself publishes, so the picture and the paragraph are the same release.
focus: The Ivrit Sheli tour, desktop, phone and Hebrew RTL frames are the current 2.12.3 interface
Every capture is taken from the upstream project's own published proof set, not re-shot here
The frames are stored in a format the profile's payload verifier actually measures
The caption claims exactly what upstream reviewed, and names the gates it does not cover
EN, ES and HE carry the same corrected sentence
release.public_data_boundary: Only public repository facts, deterministic or synthetic demonstration visuals and reviewed sanitized live captures are included; no private learning history, wellness history, runtime database record, secret, provider credential or personal export is published.

portfolio_sync.demo_boundary: A free Render service runs the 2.12.3 source as staging for a private pilot, not as production. Moved from Singapore to Frankfurt on 2026-09-12 and renamed, so the URL no longer says staging. Verified against the live host that day: /health/live at 0.149 s against 0.287 s from the old Singapore service, /health/ready with postgresql true and a 240-entry dictionary, /version reporting 2.12.3, a strict production CSP with default-src 'self', HSTS for a year with includeSubDomains, a Secure HttpOnly SameSite=lax session cookie, and a Google OAuth redirect using PKCE with the exact new callback. /health/ready still costs about 2 s in both regions because the database is far from either. The free plan sleeps after 15 minutes and the wake-up is not a fixed cost: two measurements the same day gave 38.6 s and 218 s, so a first request can take minutes. Anyone checking the service should wait before concluding it is down. The human Hebrew-content and first-learner gates remain open, and no v2.12.3 tag exists. The historical Railway service is offline.
portfolio_sync.visual_proof_state: The private 2.12.3 candidate defines 240 reviewed concepts and 240 exact semantic scenes.
portfolio_sync.interactive_browser_qa: The privacy-reviewed 2.12.3 candidate README selection represents the 240-scene candidate and is recorded in assets/readme/proof/2.12.3/manifest.json. Its five WebP assets and non-looping GIF passed source-manifest, hash, two-pass byte-identity, full-size, GitHub-scale, privacy and grayscale review on 2026-08-27. A fresh FastAPI-served 2.12.3 process also passed entry-asset discovery and a bounded Playwright smoke before capture. The immutable assets/readme/proof/2.12.2 directory remains historical published-release evidence. The full 2.12.3 Playwright matrix, contact-sheet recognition, provider verification and deployment remain separate gates.
portfolio_sync.oauth_boundary: Historical 2.4.0 production evidence verified identity-only Google sign-in, reload continuity, logout and signed-out persistence on 2026-07-21. It does not prove current hosted availability, a live GitHub session, re-login after logout, provider connector calls, two-real-user isolation or backup restoration.
